name: io.github.tony88pisa/jarvis-tools
title: Jarvis Tools
description: Residential-Chrome render_page, token_verdict, multi-source research. Free tier.

tools.name: render_page
tools.description: Render a JavaScript-heavy page with real headless Chrome on a residential IP and return title, meta, headings, main text and top links. Passes anti-bot walls that block datacenter scrapers.

wait_ms.description: Extra settle wait after load (300-5000, default 900)

max_chars.description: Max text chars to return (1000-80000, default 40000)

tools.name: token_verdict
tools.description: Deterministic security verdict for an EVM token (SAFE/CAUTION/DANGER + score 0-100) from GoPlus Security and DexScreener: honeypot, mintable, hidden owner, taxes, liquidity, top holders. Batch up to 50 addresses.

tools.name: research
tools.description: Multi-source web research: GitHub repos, Hacker News, Wikipedia, arXiv — merged and deduplicated with source labels.
